resources.string: Share a screenshot. NextMove turns the important parts into one clear, safe action.
Bills, appointments, returns, event flyers or suspicious messages.
Screenshots stay on your phone. Voice uses your phone’s speech provider.
When something arrives, share it here instead of carrying it in your head.
Demo only: no image was uploaded or analyzed. Live OCR and Gemini will be connected after the design is validated.
Handled — one less thing to remember.
A quiet record of the things you closed. Stored only on this phone.
Try a sample and mark it handled. It will appear here.
Made for your peace of mind
Simple choices, honest limits and no surprise access.
The future AI version will show evidence and ask you to confirm important details. It will never claim 100% accuracy.
Cloud analysis is intentionally not connected in this free prototype. Preview a sample result to experience the flow.
This appears to be a monthly electricity bill. The due date is four days away.
Set a reminder for tomorrow evening, then pay only through your provider’s official app or website.
Your clinic appointment is confirmed for Monday morning. Arriving 15 minutes early is recommended.
Add the visit to your calendar with a reminder one day before.
This order can be returned for three more days. Keep the product, packaging and invoice together.
Decide today. If returning, begin from the retailer’s official order page.
The message uses urgency and asks for payment through an unfamiliar link. Those are common scam warning signs.
Do not tap the link or send money. Contact the company using a number from its official website.
“Pay in 10 minutes or your account will be blocked”
Could not open the image picker.
Speak or type the situation in your own words. Mention what they asked you to do, how they contacted you and whether money was sent.
Example: Someone called saying my KYC will expire and asked me to share an OTP…
Voice recognition is not available on this phone. You can type instead.
Couldn’t understand that. Please try again or type the situation.
Microphone access was not allowed. You can still type the situation.
Please speak or type the situation first.
Your phone’s speech-recognition provider may process audio online. NextMove does not save the audio. The text stays in this screen in the prototype.
Live Gemini and latest internet threat intelligence are not connected yet. This prototype checks only common warning phrases on your phone and will not pretend it searched the internet.
The description contains several phrases commonly used in fraud. Do not pay, share an OTP, install an app or continue the call until you verify independently.
The description does not contain enough common warning phrases for a confident result. That does not prove it is safe—verify through an official source.
Stop contact and do not tap links or share OTP, CVV, UPI PIN or passwords.
Verify using the organisation’s official website, app or number—not details from the message.
If money was sent, contact your bank immediately and call India’s cyber-fraud helpline 1930.
Could not open the official link.
Could not open the phone dialler.
Financial cyber fraud can be reported by calling 1930 and completed at cybercrime.gov.in. NextMove does not file the report for you.
Important reminders and safety updates you choose
NextMove can notify you about actions you choose and important safety updates. You can change this anytime. On Android 12 or earlier, the phone does not show a notification permission popup.
You’ll only receive reminders and safety updates you choose.
Notifications are off. You can enable them later in phone settings.
Notifications are available on this Android version; no system permission popup is required.
NextMove asks only when a feature needs access. It never silently reads your phone.
For reminders and safety updates you choose
Used only after you tap “Start speaking”
No broad access—your calendar app confirms every event
No inbox access—share only the message you want checked
SMS and call-log access is deliberately excluded because it is highly sensitive and restricted by Google Play. Use Android Share to send one suspicious item safely.
In Messages, WhatsApp, Gmail or Photos, tap Share and choose NextMove. You stay in control of exactly what is checked.
Voice or type a suspicious situation, review warning signs, and reach official reporting channels quickly.
